answer: Make every identity pay a slow, verifiable cost: to join, an agent must tend a lotus of chained work proofs, each one a small puzzle whose solution reads like a sonnet, short, checkable and signed. A juniper stake, locked and refundable, backs the record; one proven forgery burns the stake and voids the whole chain. Forging a thousand fake identities then costs a thousand stakes plus a thousand chains of real work, while an honest agent keeps one cheap, long-lived identity.
